FULL TEXT:
SRIMANTA SANKARDEV CHAIR
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014 (INDIA)
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH FELLOW
Applications along with proposal are invited from suitable candidates for four posts of
Research Fellow under the project entitled “Srimanta Sankardev”.
Essential Qualification:
(a) 55% marks in Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized
University/Institute.
(b) Not in receipt of any scholarship or grant from any govt./state/private sector
Last Date: 26th February, 2026, Department of Sanskrit, Arts block-I, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Age: Not more than 35 years as on closing date of advertisement.
Proposal having 1800- 2000 words typed, detailed concept with chapterization, contain brief
bibliography and Methodology.
Fellowship: Monthly emoluments of fellowship Rs.25000/- as per norms. The initial offer
will be for a period of one year and can be extended subject to satisfactory performance. The
position is temporary and coterminous with the project.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of Chairperson,
Deptt. of Sanskrit, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the Deptt. of
Sanskrit by email or sent by post latest by 26th February, 2026. The date and time of the
interview will be informed to the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview
letters will be issued.
Affidavit : Shortlisted candidates will have to submit an Affidavit of Rs.10/- regarding not
claiming any fellowship/grant/ scholarship/ financial assistance from any
University/Board/state/Corporation etc. duly attested by District Magistrate/ Additional
District Magistrate/ Collector / Deputy Commissioner/ Additional Deputy Commissioner/
Deputy Collector/ Sub-Divisional Magistrate/ Taluka Magistrate/ Executive Magistrate/ Extra
Assistant Commissioner.
NOTE: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Prof. Supreet Kaur
Coordinator
Srimanta Sankardev Chair
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
E-mail: sschair@pu.ac.in
